hints.title: Day of Year Conversion
hints.text: Convert each date string 'MM-DD' into an absolute day of the year (1 to 365) using month lengths for a non-leap year.

hints.title: Interval Intersection
hints.text: Alice stays in range [arriveA, leaveA] and Bob stays in range [arriveB, leaveB]. Find the overlapping interval [start, end].

hints.title: Overlap Length
hints.text: The start of the intersection is max(arriveA, arriveB) and the end is min(leaveA, leaveB). If start is less than or equal to end, the count is end - start + 1, otherwise 0.

hints.title: Day Conversion and Range Overlap Implementation

variables: date strings: fixed length format MM-DD
complexity.notes: Constant-time date conversions and interval intersection arithmetic.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Day-by-day simulated calendars complicate simple interval boundaries.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 12-element month array provides instantaneous day-of-year translations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Converts calendar strings into 1D coordinate intervals to compute intersection in constant time.
